name: work-capture
description: Standalone work-capture toolkit (two skills, no downstream/vault assumptions): work-capture turns the current AI thread into a memory doc (logic/problems/decisions/recall); branch-review reads git diff vs a base branch and produces a change explanation (change flowchart + data-flow narrative + change details). Outputs tagged source:work-capture / source:branch-review with ticket/branch correlation keys; directly usable anywhere.
